about.title: About the prototype
about.p1: This is a minimum viable product (MVP) of the Armenian cultural heritage portal built according to the technical specification in docs/tz-heritage-portal.md. It shows how the aggregation pipeline, search, object pages and multilingual interface work together.
about.p2: The portal brings together four sources: the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation, monuments of Armenia from Wikidata, Armenian periodicals from the BULAC digital library BiNA and the Index of Armenian Manuscripts (IArM). {records} records are published. Another {candidates} Goskatalog candidate records need manual review and are not published.
about.p3: Metadata are shown in the language of the source: Russian, Armenian, English or French. For Wikidata monuments the title and description follow the interface language when available. People, places and subjects are linked automatically with the project's term registry. Every record states its terms of use; images are loaded from the source server.
about.p4: Interface translations are drafts and have to be checked by native speakers before public launch.
about.not_included: Europeana (needs an API key), ARAR and the National Library of Armenia (need permission), machine translation of metadata, local image copies with IIIF Image API, administration and curator review queue, user accounts, map and timeline, OAI-PMH.
